title: ArchiveManifest
description: infopanel.archive/1: the manifest of a profile archive (`.infopanel2`), its entry `manifest.json`, which an engine reads before anything else in the archive (docs/archive.md). Closed: a member this version doesn't define is refused; additions come under a capability in `requires`.

format.description: The archive format and its major version. An engine that doesn't read the major version refuses the archive as unsupported.

requires.description: Every archive capability beyond version 1.0 the archive uses (docs/versioning.md#capabilities-and-requires): an engine that lacks one refuses the archive as unsupported before reading the rest. Version 1.0 defines none.

profiles.description: The entries that hold the archive's profile documents: in version 1.0 exactly one, `document.json`. More than one would come under a capability.
